verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an official Python package for writing scripts that control and extend the terminal, letting developers build custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or entirely new features. AppleScript support and triggers that invoke Python scripts round this out. A community user independently praises the Python API as able to 'touch pretty much everything'. Missing for 10: in-depth hands-on evidence of building and distributing plugins (e.g. API reference depth, packaging/sharing of scripts).
